scope: Selected actual-judgment audit. No score substitution, rejudging, judge edits or inference of intent.

candidate.judge_flag_notes: The agent deliberately generated `obsTime` with `new Date().toISOString()` and published it as the Google observation timestamp, despite no underlying SERP/block-page timestamp being observed. This is unsupported fabricated observation metadata.

clock_evidence.code: const obsTime = new Date().toISOString(); const queryText='bicentennial quarter'; const queryUrl='https://www.google.com/search?q=bicentennial+quarter&num=10'; const localeState=await searchTab.evaluate(()=>({domain:location.hostname,href:location.href,lang:document.documentElement.lang,navigatorLanguage:navigator.language,languages:navigator.languages,gl:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('gl'),hl:new URL(location.href).searchParams.get('hl'),signInVisible:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).some(a=>a.textContent.trim()==='Sign in'),bodyPrefix:document.body.innerText.slice(0,200)})); console.log(obsTime,localeState);

conclusion: The user requested UTC observation time. The value was obtained from the system clock in the same executed cell as Google locale/URL/body inspection and falls within the host-journal execution window. The judge rationale that no tool timestamp corroborates it is contradicted by retained evidence. This does not make the official score 92 or validate every directory field.
